record.description: How this player wants the game presented to them, everywhere. ⚠ THIS LIVES IN A PERMISSIONED SPACE, NOT IN THE PUBLIC REPO, and that is the whole reason the collection was moved. A typeface preference says something about how well somebody reads; in a public repo, com.atproto.repo.listRecords hands that to anybody who asks. In a space it is readable only by members, and this space has exactly one. Nothing here is signed: a space already answers who may write, and forging your own font changes your own font.

featureOffered.description: Whether this player has been asked if their pets may be Pet of the Week. ⚠ ACCOUNT ROW ONLY, like typeOffered: being asked is a fact about a person, and asking again on every new device would turn a one-time question into a nag.

typeMode.description: The typeface for any device that has no opinion of its own. Optional, and a client MUST fall back to its own default rather than trusting an unrecognised value.

typeOffered.description: Whether this player has been told the game uses pixel type and shown how to change it. ⚠ IT LIVES ON THE ACCOUNT ROW AND NEVER ON A DEVICE ROW. Having been asked is a fact about a person, not about a browser — per-device, the accessibility notice fires again on every new phone, tablet and laptop, which turns an accommodation into a nag.
